item.text: I’m going to make the smallest possible edit: change the `calcTotal` loop bound so it stops before `items.length`.

I couldn’t apply the fix because the workspace is currently read-only and approvals are disabled.

The required one-line fix is:

```diff
-  for (let i = 0; i <= items.length; i++) {
+  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
```

This fixes the crash by preventing `calcTotal` from reading past the end of `items`.
